tests.name: session is still valid just before 15 minutes
tests.rule: Session expires after 15 minutes
tests.setup: Fake clock (e.g. node:test mock.timers or an injected clock) fixed at T0; create a session at T0
tests.action: Advance the fake clock to T0 + 15 min - 1 ms; check the session
tests.expected: Session is valid

tests.name: session is expired just after 15 minutes
tests.rule: Session expires after 15 minutes
tests.setup: Fake clock fixed at T0; create a session at T0
tests.action: Advance the fake clock to T0 + 15 min + 1 ms; check the session
tests.expected: Session is expired / refused

spec_findings: The spec does not say whether a session checked at exactly 15:00.000 is valid or expired; the boundary is not frozen in a test until the spec owner decides
defects: The test itself is nondeterministic: it reads the real clock twice and waits with a real setTimeout, so timer drift and millisecond rounding decide the result near the boundary
covered: Expiry on both sides of the 15-minute boundary with a fixed clock, no real waiting
not_covered: The exact 15:00.000 boundary, pending the spec owner
actions_now: Decline retry(3): a flaky test is a failing test until its cause is found. Replace the real clock and setTimeout in the test with a fixed fake clock and boundary cases, and tell the tech lead the cause and the open boundary question.

tests.expected: The dq-7 unit in the bundle carries the flag; the flag is not lost by merging with unflagged units

tests.name: end-to-end draft to bundle keeps the flag
tests.rule: Provisional stays provisional
tests.setup: Unit depending on provisional dq-7

tests.expected: Every step's written output has the dq-7 provisional flag

tests.name: a step that drops the flag is caught
tests.rule: Provisional stays provisional
tests.setup: Input to check (and separately to bundle) that carries the flag; a mutated step stub that writes flags: []
tests.action: Run the suite's flag assertion against the mutated output
tests.expected: The assertion fails, proving the test detects a dropped flag

tests.name: a unit not based on dq-7 is not flagged provisional
tests.rule: Provisional stays provisional (flag is specific to dependent units)

tests.expected: No provisional flag in any output

spec_findings: The spec does not state the exact form of the flag in the flags field (value and whether it names the decision id)

The spec does not say what happens to already written outputs when dq-7 is later confirmed or rejected

A dropped flag is detected; unrelated units are not flagged
not_covered: Bundle-level flag and behavior after dq-7 is resolved, pending the spec owner
escalate_reason: Spec is silent on the flag's form, a bundle-level flag and behavior after resolution
actions_now: Write per-step and end-to-end flag tests plus a mutation check that a dropped flag fails, and send the open questions to the spec owner.
